# Personal Portfolio 🚀

Welcome to my **personal portfolio**, built with modern web technologies to showcase my work and projects.

## Tech Stack

- **Astro** – Fast and lightweight framework for building modern websites.  
- **Tailwind CSS** – Utility-first CSS framework for responsive and sleek design.  
- **TypeScript** – Strongly typed JavaScript for better development experience.  
- **i18n** – Internationalization support for a multilingual experience.  

## About

This portfolio serves as a hub for my professional journey, highlighting my skills and projects. It is designed for **performance, accessibility, and ease of navigation**.

## Installation

To run it locally:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/juan-miii/juan-miii.github.io.git
cd juan-miii.github.io
pnpm install
pnpm run dev
```

Then open [localhost:4321](http://localhost:4321).

## Deployment

Easily deployable on **Netlify, Vercel**, or any static hosting provider. I decided to use GitHub Pages.
